title: Physics of Information Systems
subtitle: First-principles essays on the categorical gap between reality and its representations, and what that gap forces every information system to do.
abstract: A multi-part publication exploring information systems from first principles — starting from the categorical difference between reality and the signs a system stores in its place, and building outward toward how information is captured, held, and acted on.
author: Shreyas Agarwal

children.title: The Territory Exists Before the Map
